youtube.aciklama: OTOF gene therapy trials published since 2024 have reported improved hearing and speech perception in most treated children; but these are small, early-phase trials without a control group and with short follow-up, and the treatment applies only to specific single-gene losses. Proven options for a child's access to language today are hearing aids and cochlear implants; no research should be a reason to delay them.
